Definition: to be soft or pliable, i.e. (figuratively) effeminate or luxurious
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be soft, be delicate, be dainty; 1a) (Pual) to be delicate; 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to be of dainty habit, be pampered; 1b2) to be happy about, take exquisite delight; 1b3) to make merry over, make sport of
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
